blurb: Guests join private sailing charters to see wildlife and dolphins, help with sailing, and enjoy scenic views including sunsets. Trips range from morning, afternoon, sunset sails to customizable half and full day excursions. The fleet consists of newest, luxurious monohull vessels with amenities like cockpit cushions, bimini tops, and restrooms.

cancellation: A decision to cancel for weather is SOLELY up to the Captains. Weather cancellations are rare. If WE view there is a risk, we will look at delaying the departure time, rescheduling the trip if we both have the ability to reschedule, or canceling the trip and providing a full refund. A decision to cancel for weather is SOLELY up to the professional discretion of our experienced Captains. If we determine there is a risk of unfavorable weather, we may delay the departure time, reschedule the trip if possible, or cancel the trip if absolutely necessary.
